tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Please refer tender document for all the terms & conditions

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a manufacturer/authorized dealer of Lufkin make gear box and its spares. shall have successfully supplied Lufkin make gear box and its spares to any State Gov. PSU/Central Gov. PSU thermal power plant or any utility industries and in proof of the same, the bidder shall upload manufacturing certificate/Dealer certificate and copies of Purchase orders amounting to Rs.20.68 lakhs or above

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Manufacturer/Authorised dealership certificate and Past PO copies

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have achieved, in his name/firm, an average annual turnover of Rs.41.37Lakhs in at least two financial years in the preceding five financial years i.e., 2024-25, 2023-24, 2022-23, 2021-22 and 2020-21. As a proof of this, the bidder shall furnish Annual Turnover Certificate/Profit & Loss Statement duly certified by a charted accountant.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Duly filled specification schedule mentioning make, model, delivery period, GST, HSN code clearly
